notes: Biology and biotechnology machines: 8 configurations from 7 manufacturers (Thermo Fisher Scientific x2, Leica Microsystems x2, Oxford Cryosystems, Chart/MVE, PHC, Martin Christ). None duplicates the existing catalog (Leica CM1950, Planer Kryo 560, Retsch CryoMill, Labconco FreeZone 6, Kitazato Cryotop). Temperatures converted exactly from Celsius ((C+273.15)x1000 mK). Absences (install not_available) are only used where a complete technical specification or component list is available (manual technical-data chapters, data sheets); for the Leica EM AFS2 only a brochure exists, so magnet and sample wiring stay unknown. Humidity lower bounds for the plunge freezers are the manufacturers' maximum room humidity (85 % Vitrobot, 55 % EM GP2), because the control range starts at room humidity. Vapour-LN2 storage temperature recorded as the stated -190 C top-box value (lo = hi). Christ final vacuum (about 0.005 mbar) depends on the pump. Not covered because no reachable full specification was found: Leica EM ICE high-pressure freezer (brochure/spec page give no pressure, temperature or carrier data), Leica EM FC7 cryo-ultramicrotome (manual >10 MB, brochure technical pages not retrievable), SPEX Freezer/Mill (electromagnetic coil field at the vial is unspecified), Thermo CryoMed controlled-rate freezer (manual not retrievable). Tavily was unavailable (plan limit); sources were read with WebFetch and pdftotext. accessed 2026-11-01.
